mapper.select: SELECT s.SUPPLIER_ID, s.SUPPLIER_NAME, s.SUPPLIER_TYPE, COUNT(p.PROJECT_ID) AS projectCount, SUM(p.ACTUAL_AMOUNT) AS totalAmount FROM TBL_SUPPLIER s LEFT JOIN TBL_PROCUREMENT_PROJECT p ON s.SUPPLIER_ID = p.SUPPLIER_ID AND s.COMPANY_ID = #{companyId} GROUP BY s.SUPPLIER_ID, s.SUPPLIER_NAME, s.SUPPLIER_TYPE ORDER BY totalAmount DESC
